arguments.value: Covington, Virginia Maria Hernandez is a United States District Judge for the Middle District of Florida, taking senior status in 2020 after being appointed to the bench in 2004. Born in Tampa, Florida, she earned a B.S. from the University of Tampa in 1976, an M.B.A. from the University of Tampa in 1977, and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 1980. Her legal career included service as a trial attorney with the Federal Trade Commission, assistant state attorney in Florida’s Thirteenth Judicial Circuit, and assistant U.S. attorney for the Middle District of Florida, where she worked in the Civil Division and later served as chief of the Asset Forfeiture Section. She also served as a judge on Florida’s Second District Court of Appeal from 2001 to 2004.
